leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a controlled component to manage form state in React
Construct a custom hook to encapsulate and reuse stateful logic
Apply the Context API to share data across multiple components
Configure a higher-order component to enhance component functionality
Manipulate component rendering using conditional logic and lists
Integrate prop types for runtime type checking in components
Initialize and update state using the useState hook in functional components
